text: ok so Chloe is 6 and was diagnosed with type 1 in the spring and honestly we're still learning so bear with me. She wears an Omnipod and a Libre. If her number is under 70 give her 4 glucose tabs (NOT the whole tube, she'll try) and check again in 15 minutes. Above 250 just text me, I'm in the building. It's not like she never feels her lows, she does sometimes, but don't rely on her telling you, check the Libre if she's pale or cranky.

traps.why: Low treatment is 4 glucose tabs, not more.
